5.0.2.title: Unique biome completion
5.0.2.details: Biome reports and banners use required captures and the party-needed checks you enable in Safari → Modes → Sparkling Checks Options. Use !sparkle <critter> on/off to change an optional check for the party or !sparkle after clear on/off to show remaining checks after a clear.

5.0.2.title: Party mode commands and dye streaks
5.0.2.details: Use !unique, !fc, or !sparkle to switch Safari modes for the party. Use !since dye to see each responding player's saved runs since their last Emerald Dye. See !commands for the grouped command list.

5.0.2.title: Share Config
5.0.2.details: Copy a code for your settings and HUD layout, then paste it into Share Config in another instance. The import backs up previous settings and leaves account details and Safari records intact.

5.0.2.title: Custom Sparkling celebrations
5.0.2.details: Build a catch celebration from individual effects, music, and text. Preview a draft, save named presets, or share your recipe. All existing styles and catch triggers are still available.

5.0.2.title: Party Ready banner
5.0.2.details: See when your party is ready in Torrhus Canyon. The banner checks your contest ticket and party chat confirmations from each teammate. Customize it under Safari → Banner → Contest alerts.

5.0.2.title: Doomspiral Gambling
5.0.2.details: Nearby players can join the lottery animation when the ritual starts stirring. Everyone's animation ends at the same point in the ritual, and the Sparkling Found sound waits for the reveal to finish.

5.0.2.title: Hotspot HUD and preferences
5.0.2.details: See teammate hotspots reported through SafariUtils. Click Preferences in local chat after turning on Hotspot assigning, or use /hotspot preferences.

5.0.2.title: Safari capture tools
5.0.2.details: Turn on Recatch waypoint to mark confirmed capsule attempts and recent escapes. Left-click to leave a Gazer bed in Haunted. Find both under Safari → Helpers → Capture tools.

5.0.2.title: Visible highlights and remaining checks
5.0.2.details: Rockmite mound glow outlines visible mounds, and Recatch waypoint follows line of sight. After a Unique clear, you can show the remaining party-needed Sparkling checks in Biome Objectives.

5.0.2.title: Per-critter ESP controls
5.0.2.details: Choose glow and boxes for each critter under ESP → General. Linked drops and structures follow those controls. Rockmite mound glow can outline the mound model.

5.0.2.title: Sparkling checks after a Unique clear
5.0.2.details: After a Unique clear, bring back party-needed objectives and highlights for unchecked nests, mounds, and walls. The Missing panel reads All captured, and the Progress HUD keeps the biome marked complete.

5.0.0.title: Recover Safari history from old logs
5.0.0.details: Copy logs from earlier Safari runs into your current instance’s logs folder, then choose Import logs in History. The importer can link midnight rollovers, match former names to your account, and backfill Main runs and sparklings while preserving live records.

5.0.0.title: Safari encounter counts
5.0.0.details: Stats shows Doomspiral and Wumpa checks. Ask for recorded counts in party chat with !doom, !wumpa, or !gemzie. Opening Vincent’s Dye Guide can sync your personal Emerald Dye total.

5.0.0.title: API capture stats and live milestones
5.0.0.details: Open Stats to refresh your API capture total and biome breakdown. Capture milestones count new personal catches as you play. Recorded run time and /playtimedetailed are shown separately.

5.0.0.title: Sparkling Critterdex
5.0.0.details: Open the Critterdex from Sparklings for biome progress and counts for all 37 critters. Choose a dex tier and jump back to any history tab. Start a new session directly from Profit.

5.0.0.title: Party sync recovery
5.0.0.details: Party sync preserves the current visit through temporary disconnects. Supported providers can add new party members to the existing connection. The backup connects after sustained primary failure.

5.0.0.title: Per-critter ESP controls
5.0.0.details: Set glow outlines and boxes separately for each critter. You can also keep intact Rockmite mounds and remaining Sparkling checks highlighted after completing the relevant objectives.

4.4.5.title: Sparkling Checks Options
4.4.5.details: Optional Unique-mode checks turn off once with this update. Enable party-requested checks under Safari → Modes. Biome reports, the Biome complete banner, and /rates follow your choices. Sparkling mode keeps its usual checks.

4.4.5.title: Stable Forest and Haunted HUDs
4.4.5.details: Fixed flickering progress and objective displays while holding starting bird food or Shining Coins with starting-item announcements off.

4.4.5.title: Biome Hotspot Preferences
4.4.5.details: Rank the four biomes under Party → Interactions. Supported party sync servers use your ranking in equal-win ties.

4.4.5.title: Hotspots run counter
4.4.5.details: The HUD counts the current run after you join Safari and keeps counting when the same party resumes after a break.

4.4.5.title: Sparkling catch totals
4.4.5.details: Party catch announcements show the recorded catch number for that sparkling. A first catch displays #1 (NEW!).

4.4.5.title: Quieter contest chat
4.4.5.details: Removed the automatic follow-up listing teammates still waiting to confirm their tickets.

4.4.5.title: Standard sightings and highlights
4.4.5.details: Sparkling alerts can use visible skins and corroborated particles. Alerts that start stay visible for their full duration. Partially visible critters retain a depth-tested box when whole-model glow is unavailable.

4.4.5.title: Hideyho banner removed
4.4.5.details: Standard no longer shows the Hideyho inside/outside location banner.

4.4.5.title: Hideyho location banner
4.4.5.details: This update turns the inside/outside banner back on once. You can turn it off under Safari → Banner → Encounter alerts → Hideyho location.

4.4.5.title: Sparkle Warping transfer delay
4.4.5.details: Automatic warps give teammates up to two seconds to finish traveling before the entry window closes. Your Reparty and Warp sliders still set the base timing.

4.4.5.title: Auto Update is enabled once
4.4.5.details: Full turns on verified automatic downloads the first time you launch this update. You can turn Auto Update off in the update screen, and that choice is saved.

4.4.4.title: Edition-specific What's New
4.4.4.details: See release highlights for your installed edition. Each edition remembers where you left off.

4.4.4.title: Torrhus Honeyhive markers
4.4.4.details: See beacons for ready hives from a distance using known Torrhus locations and saved refill timers.

4.4.4.title: Standard Highlights
4.4.4.details: Choose glow and boxes separately under Highlights → General. Visible Scrappies share one customizable color.

4.4.4.title: Safari party alerts
4.4.4.details: Party leaders announce pending downtime requests upon returning to Torrhus Canyon. A banner shows when a teammate reports a kick during Safari.

4.4.4.title: Hideyho keybind setup
4.4.4.details: Bind Accept Hideyho Quest at startup or in Safari Helpers. Press the key after Hideyho offers the quest in chat.

4.4.3.title: Shared edition settings
4.4.3.details: Switch editions in the same Minecraft instance and keep your HUD layouts, shared settings, edition preferences, and Safari records.

4.4.3.title: Standard Safari visuals
4.4.3.details: Standard glows clearly visible critters, marks live floor drops with a generic tile, and shows known Snoozle wall waypoints through terrain. Capsule trajectory previews and the Doomspiral lottery are available under Safari Helpers.

4.4.3.title: Settings reset and progress HUD controls
4.4.3.details: Restore default settings or turn off configurable features from the Reset tab. Saved Safari records stay intact. Customize each progress row or show just the timer.

4.4.3.title: Party sparkling commands
4.4.3.details: Use !sparkling to look up a player’s total, unique, and duplicate sparklings. Use !rates to see each responding party member’s session catches and runs per sparkling.

4.4.3.title: In-game update downloads
4.4.3.details: Choose whether to download updates for your Minecraft version from the update screen.

4.4.2.title: Biome Objectives controls
4.4.2.details: Choose which objective rows to show and which optional sparkling checks your run should require. Skipped checks no longer hold up biome completion or appear in your missing-objectives reply.

4.4.2.title: Safari Splits HUD
4.4.2.details: See when each biome finishes in Unique or Full Clear. Customize the time precision and show a compact summary of your current session.

4.4.2.title: Party profit commands
4.4.2.details: Use !profit with session, lifetime, week, or day. Each responding player reports their own saved Safari profit and the Bazaar pricing method used.

4.4.2.title: Safari capture stats
4.4.2.details: See a player’s total critter captures and biome counts in /sparkling. In party chat, use !captures for your own stats or !captures followed by an IGN.

4.4.2.title: Ubik’s Cube cooldown
4.4.2.details: Track the Rift’s Split or Steal cooldown across relogs. Enable the timer under SkyBlock → Helpers.

4.4.1.title: Hotspot party run count
4.4.1.details: The Hotspot HUD counts completed runs with your current party. Saved history preserves the count across reconnects, and roster changes start a new streak.

4.4.1.title: Personal best messages
4.4.1.details: Choose which boss and biome PB messages appear in local chat. Messages now include the relevant best time.

4.4.1.title: More reliable capture tracking
4.4.1.details: Improved how catch confirmations and capsule escapes match Shyworms, Hideon critters, and Rockmite mounds.

4.4.1.title: Doomspiral Lottery reveal
4.4.1.details: The reels reveal the result earlier and give regular and Sparkling Doomspirals distinct animated text.

4.4.0.title: Critter nameplates
4.4.0.details: Choose vanilla tags, custom markers, both, or neither. Customize distance, pity, colors, and visibility by critter.

4.4.0.title: Connection recovery
4.4.0.details: Two opt-in settings can reconnect after an unexpected Hypixel disconnect and return to SkyBlock from Prototype or Limbo.

4.4.0.title: Easier settings navigation
4.4.0.details: Find critter names, highlight colors, and HUD appearance in grouped settings pages.

4.3.9.title: HUD text customization
4.3.9.details: Give supported HUDs a custom title and choose separate colors for headings, labels, and values. HUD Appearance settings are available from the editor.

4.3.9.title: World ESP customization
4.3.9.details: Critter names, nameplates, and highlight colors moved to Customization.

4.3.9.title: Biome Objectives reminders
4.3.9.details: Capture and sparkling-check reminders can be turned on or off individually.

4.3.8.title: Custom critter names
4.3.8.details: Rename any of the 37 critters in your local interface, including HUDs, alerts, and history. Party chat uses official names.

4.3.8.title: Party Hotspot controls
4.3.8.details: Use !hotspot on or !hotspot off to change Hotspot assigning for Sparkling Mutuals users in your party.

4.3.7.title: Adjustable Sparkle Warping
4.3.7.details: Set the reparty and automatic warp deadlines separately. The reparty deadline also ends auto-party invites. Defaults are 22 seconds and 27 seconds.

4.3.7.title: HUD fonts and transparency
4.3.7.details: Use your resource pack’s font on mod HUDs and alerts. Background transparency now works the same way across HUD settings.

4.3.7.title: Emerald Dye party count
4.3.7.details: Use !dye to see each responding player’s recorded Emerald Dye drops.

4.3.5.title: Critter highlights and biome colors
4.3.5.details: Choose glow outlines or boxes, and set one color per biome or individual critter colors.

4.3.5.title: Custom ticket messages
4.3.5.details: Turn ticket-earned party messages on or off and set separate wording for Basic and First-Class tickets.

4.3.4.title: Hunting Box shard guidance
4.3.4.details: Compare sell offers, instant selling, and salvaging for all 37 Safari shards. Hover a row to see the estimated value and how its seven-day trading volume compares with other Safari shards.

4.3.4.title: Daily Warp List refresh
4.3.4.details: The list checks for newly acquired sparklings once a day while connected to Hypixel, removes confirmed matches, and updates invite priorities.

4.3.4.title: HUD growth direction
4.3.4.details: Choose which direction HUDs grow as their contents change. Fresh installs use matching black backgrounds and border settings.

4.3.4.title: All Scannable Critter Checks
4.3.4.details: An optional Sparkle mode setting tracks ordinary scannable critters until checked, even when the party already owns their sparkling variants.

4.3.2.title: Safari sync during reconnects
4.3.2.details: The primary and backup servers preserve finalized Hotspot assignments and share corrected critter completion. Late arrivals can report their hotspot without moving assigned players.

4.3.1.title: Hotspot instructions and win counts
4.3.1.details: Party leaders can recover missing assignment messages after a reconnect. The Hotspot HUD retains the party’s last confirmed win counts while a new tally loads.

4.3.0.title: Shared critter progress
4.3.0.details: Compatible clients share per-critter completion for Safari mode displays. Local catches, history, and profit continue to come from your own run data.

4.3.0.title: Safari HUD and alert additions
4.3.0.details: Added a profitable critter checklist, a personal Lake Cleared alert, an entry cooldown timer, and a Hotspot HUD option to show only your own result.

4.2.2.title: Settings search and HUD shortcuts
4.2.2.details: Search across category and option names. Right-click a HUD in /sm gui to open its settings.

4.2.2.title: Backup Safari sync
4.2.2.details: Compatible clients can switch to an independent backup connection while preserving shared objectives, catches, and assignments during service interruptions.

4.2.1.title: Doomspiral Lottery visuals
4.2.1.details: The lottery gained a teal slot cabinet, scrolling reels, and a gold celebration for sparkling results.

4.2.0.title: Doomspiral Lottery
4.2.0.details: Watch a slot-machine reveal when Doomspiral is summoned nearby. The overlay hides spoilers until the result.

4.2.0.title: Sparkling Auto-entry updates
4.2.0.details: Automatically select the lowest available Safari ticket after a confirmed sparkling warp, including while tabbed out. Successful entry announces you in party chat.

4.1.2.title: Floor-drop visibility
4.1.2.details: Choose which supply types stay highlighted across modes.

4.1.2.title: Safari chat filters
4.1.2.details: Choose which types of Safari chat messages to hide.

4.1.2.title: Remembered history views
4.1.2.details: History tabs remember your scroll position, filters, and selections when reopened.

4.1.1.title: Profit periods and saved sessions
4.1.1.details: Review profit by day, week, or session in history. Use /newsession to file the current session and start another.

4.1.1.title: Safari visibility controls
4.1.1.details: Keep selected critters highlighted across modes.

4.1.1.title: Hideyho location banner customization
4.1.1.details: Customize the banner that shows where Hideyho appears.

4.1.0.title: Shared Safari coordination
4.1.0.details: Sparkling Mutuals and SafariUtils can share objective evidence, sparkling sightings, and Hotspot assignments in the same run.

4.1.0.title: Sparkling Auto-entry
4.1.0.details: Opt in to ticket entry after a verified sparkling warp from your party leader.

4.1.0.title: Warp List priorities
4.1.0.details: Choose which players to invite for individual sparkling critters, with priority and availability controls for automatic invites.

4.0.2.title: Hunting Box value and market advice
4.0.2.details: See the estimated value of shards across visited Hunting Box pages and get market guidance for top Safari shards and Safari Essence.

4.0.1.title: HUD snapping
4.0.1.details: Align HUDs with guides and nudge their position a pixel at a time in the HUD editor.

4.0.1.title: Mixed-party Hotspot assigning
4.0.1.details: The party leader coordinates assignments and can tell teammates without the mod where to go in party chat.

4.0.0.title: Redesigned settings and HUDs
4.0.0.details: Settings gained search, themes, and a revised HUD editor. Biome Objectives now has a separate panel for Safari tasks and supplies.

4.0.0.title: Custom Safari alerts
4.0.0.details: Customize banners, sounds, and sparkling catch celebrations for Safari encounters and Miria’s contests.

4.0.0.title: Warp Lists and sparkling collections
4.0.0.details: Import per-player Warp Lists from CSV and explore expanded achievements, sparkling dex tiers, and run history.

4.0.0.title: Sparkling collections
4.0.0.details: Explore expanded achievements, sparkling dex tiers, and run history.

4.0.0.title: Skill overflow tooltips
4.0.0.details: See the levels and progress earned beyond a skill’s usual cap in the SkyBlock Skills menu.

3.6.4.title: Sparkle Warping party setup
3.6.4.details: Use /start to prepare the current party, save its returning players, and begin the warping cycle. Leeching can accept invites from a selected whitelist.

3.6.3.title: Hotspot assigning
3.6.3.details: Use /hotspot to coordinate who covers each Safari biome based on the party’s reported hotspots.

3.6.0.title: Mode-specific highlights
3.6.0.details: Hide critter or floor-drop highlights independently in each Safari mode.

3.6.0.title: Water opacity
3.6.0.details: Adjust the opacity of Safari water.

3.5.5.title: Clear Safari water
3.5.5.details: Reduce underwater fog and adjust water opacity while in the Safari.

3.5.4.title: Welcome shortcuts and command help
3.5.4.details: The welcome message gives quick access to settings, modes, history, and HUD editing. Use /sm help for a command list.

3.5.3.title: Safari profit rankings
3.5.3.details: Rank up to ten critters by estimated coins per run using Bazaar prices and expected captures.

3.5.0.title: Sparkling rates and profitable critters
3.5.0.details: Estimate how many runs a sparkling variant may take and use cached Bazaar data to find valuable critters.

3.4.0.title: Garden Phantomleaf Solver
3.4.0.details: Use the search sounds to narrow down possible hiding spots, shown as highlighted locations.

3.3.0.title: Sparkling skin detection
3.3.0.details: Recognize sparkling critters from known skins and names across loaded Safari biomes, with shared detection for alerts, ESP, and the nearby HUD.

3.2.0.title: Floor-drop colors
3.2.0.details: Customize highlight colors for individual supply types.

3.2.0.title: Contest downtime
3.2.0.details: Coordinate party downtime when a Miria contest begins.

3.1.0.title: Named Safari floor drops
3.1.0.details: See predicted supply types and colors on floor waypoints, with separate scaling for ESP text.

3.0.0.title: Three Safari modes
3.0.0.details: Choose Full Clear, Unique, or party-aware Sparkling mode. Progress, missing species, and capture HUDs follow your selected goal.

3.0.0.title: Safari personal bests
3.0.0.details: Track biome clear times and solo or duo boss records, with feedback when a catch sets a new best.

2.0.0.title: Safari helpers and HUDs
2.0.0.details: Configure in-run Safari displays and use party commands to coordinate runs.

1.0.2.title: Miria contest tracker
1.0.2.details: See the time left and your progress toward your ticket target.

1.0.2.title: Party warp alerts
1.0.2.details: Coordinate party warps with dedicated alerts.

1.0.1.title: Missing sparkling lookup
1.0.1.details: Use !missing with a player name to see which time-saving sparkling critters they still need.

1.0.0.title: Sparkling mutuals and tickets
1.0.0.details: Use party commands to find shared sparkling needs and look up Safari ticket counts.
